loophole_audit.evidence: test_motion_and_full_clip_contract rejects unavailable or invalid duration; test_semantic_guard checks timeline structure; test_valid_branches preserves coordinates and decoded bounds separately.

loophole_audit.criterion: Require derivatives and exact selected-index/media correspondence for frame attachments.
